about.en: Claus (CLAUS) is an Ethereum token paired in a Uniswap v4 pool whose hook implementation can be replaced after launch, so the token's trading mechanics change while the contract address and holder balances stay the same. The hooks route a share of trading fees into buybacks, supply burns, liquidity funding and NFT holder rewards. The project publishes its active hooks, onchain sources and a dated journal at claus.si.
